body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Edifier showcased its all-in-one audio system 'DREAM' at CES 2009.

Simplicity of use and operation with iPod and iPhone docking; MP3 connectivity and Digital FM tuner 'Dream' provides the user with an outstanding audio experience complimenting the today's home lifestyle imagery.
